note: The provider DID post the deliverable body (postDeliverable) and the on-chain JobSubmitted hash equals keccak256 of that 247-byte body, so the 78154 rejection was NOT a provider-side posting failure. Three stale pre-fix acp_arbitrate.ts runners were still subscribed to the buyer agent and one of them rejected the job 6s after submission with reason 'malformed-deliverable' (10:41:13Z), beating the fixed runner's complete() (10:41:15Z). The prior proof/acp_arbitration.json was produced by that race-losing complete(): the SDK waitForCallsStatus() resolves as soon as a receipt exists and does not check receipt status, so a reverted complete() looked successful. That file has been replaced by this failure record.
